score.rationale: This proposal is exceptionally well-written, demonstrating a high degree of technical and procedural maturity. It excels in technical feasibility and lifecycle linkage by precisely situating the work within an existing multi-phase project (PD-1 through PD-5), referencing specific documents, artifacts, and constraints. The problem statement is clear, focused on proving system efficacy rather than building new frameworks, and the scope is tightly controlled with explicit non-goals. The score is not perfect primarily because the acceptance criteria, while strong in their definition of outputs (the scorecard artifact and its contents), are not presented as a distinct, itemized checklist, which slightly reduces their immediate testability and clarity compared to the rest of the document.
